blocks.content: Quiz: Which property do you use to make an element a flexbox?
Tap an option below to answer:
position: flex;
Incorrect, give it another shot!
While position is a CSS property, it cannot be used to create a flexbox.
While position is a CSS property, it cannot be used to create a flexbox.
display: flex;
Correct Answer!
The display property is used to create a flexbox when set to flex.
The display property is used to create a flexbox when set to flex.
flex-container: true;
Incorrect, give it another shot!
There is no such property as flex-container in CSS.
There is no such property as flex-container in CSS.
flex: start;
Incorrect, give it another shot!
flex: start; is used to align items in a flexbox, not to make an element a flexbox.
